title: Sections formula for the etale-to-pro-etale inverse image
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, with small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], in the universes and skeletons fixed there. Let $
u_X:X_{\mathrm{proet}}	o X_{\mathrm{et}}$ be the comparison geometric morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. For a weakly etale $X$-scheme $f:Y	o X$ that is an object of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, let $f_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}F$ be the inverse image of sheaves of sets on the small etale sites, defined by the adjunction and sheafified presheaf construction in [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], and let $\Gamma(Y_{\mathrm{et}},G)=G(Y)$ denote sections at the identity etale object. The presheaf on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ with values
$$A_X(F)(Y)=\Gamma(Y_{\mathrm{et}},f_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}F)$$
and restriction along $g:Z	o Y$ given by etale section pullback followed by the canonical composition identification $g_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}f_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}F\cong(fg)_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}F$ is a sheaf. There is a canonical isomorphism of sheaves of sets $
u_X^*F\cong A_X(F)$, natural in $F$. For $U	o X$ etale, its component identifies the comparison adjunction unit $F(U)	o(
u_X^*F)(U)$ with the usual identification $F(U)\cong\Gamma(U_{\mathrm{et}},F|_{U_{\mathrm{et}}})$.
